description: Source file defining functions to generate PDSCH configuration parameters for different RNTI types in 5G NR, including handling of DMRS info, resource allocation, and configuration based on TS 38.214 specifications.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config parameters for Type 1-0 TC RNTI based on cell configuration and resource allocation.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_0_c_rnti (overload 1)
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config parameters for Type 1-0 C RNTI with default settings.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_0_c_rnti (overload 2)
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config parameters for Type 1-0 C RNTI, adjusting nof_oh_prb based on serving cell config.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config parameters for Type 1-1 C RNTI with dedicated DMRS info and configurable max CWs.
